data.body: A6-0b implementation complete at commit 93a40f7 (standard-tier worker attempts: 4). Local four-pass review round 1 found a destructive under-lock epoch fall-through; added deterministic RED races, fixed with an inner else, and expanded HEAD/dirty/rebase/reset-failure coverage. Round 2 found unexpected convergence failures aborted run_ensures under set -e; added a RED interpreter-failure test and wrapped the convergence heredoc best-effort. Final focused oracle: 26 passed; make lint, make typecheck, shell syntax, verify-commit-ticket, and final make test all pass. Final local review PASS with two accepted advisories: hardcoded origin/tickets is the ticket's explicit load-bearing review-bot clone contract, while sync.reconverge remains authoritative for compatible configured stores; LockTimeout has shared lock-suite coverage and the new RebaseGuard case exercises this script's exception/preserve path. Ready for Gerrit push.
